text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Monthly count and total amount of lost opportunities (closed and not won) in fiscal year FY26, from the opportunity_enhanced relation; the competitor-is-Splunk restriction cannot be applied because there is no governed join from this relation to the Salesforce opportunity object that holds competitor data.","measures":[{"ref":"column:SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED.OPPORTUNITY_ID","aggregation":"count_distinct","alias":"lost_count","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED","op":"eq","values":[true],"source":"question"},{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON","op":"eq","values":[false],"source":"question"}]},{"ref":"column:SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED.AMOUNT","aggregation":"sum","alias":"lost_amount","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED","op":"eq","values":[true],"source":"question"},{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON","op":"eq","values":[false],"source":"question"}]}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.CLOSE_DATE","role":"time","grain":"month"}],"display":[],"filters":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.FISCAL_YEAR","op":"eq","values":["2026"],"source":"question"}],"expectedShape":"trend","unresolved":[{"clause":"competitor involved is Splunk","options":[],"material":true}],"provenance":{"column:SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED.OPPORTUNITY_ID":"q:Lost opportunities count","column:SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED.AMOUNT":"q:Lost Amount","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED":"q:Lost opportunities","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON":"q:Lost opportunities","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.CLOSE_DATE":"q:by month","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.FISCAL_YEAR":"q:fiscal year FY26"}}
